LanguageData.Bed_Kingsize.description: An extravagant four-poster bed fit for nobility, adorned with intricate carvings. Extremely comfy and luxurious, its imposing frame and detailed craftsmanship make it a work of art. Fits two.
LanguageData.Bed_Kingsize.label: royal poster bed
LanguageData.Table_RoyalDresser.description: A luxurious dresser, adorned with solid gold and elegant in design, making nearby beds more comfortable.Placing more than one end table near the same bed has no effect.
LanguageData.Table_RoyalDresser.label: royal dresser
LanguageData.Table_RoyalEndTable.description: A finely crafted bedside table adorned with gold inlays and exquisite detailing. Enhances the comfort of nearby beds, providing a touch of nobility to any sleeping quarters. Must be placed directly adjacent to the head of the bed. Placing more than one near the same bed has no effect.
LanguageData.Table_RoyalEndTable.label: royal end table
LanguageData.VFE_RoyalLamp.description: A beautifully crafted standing lamp adorned with gold trim and elegant design.
LanguageData.VFE_RoyalLamp.label: royal standing lamp
LanguageData.VFE_RoyalWardrobe.description: A grand, gold-trimmed wardrobe designed for nobility. Gives a small comfort bonus to all nearby beds. Placing more than one royal wardrobe near the same bed has no effect.
LanguageData.VFE_RoyalWardrobe.label: royal wardrobe
